parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per request. You can use this parameter with NextToken for pagination. The maximum value is 100.

parameters.name: NamePrefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the event source name.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from a previous call.
